name: browser_console_messages
description: Return buffered console logs for the current or specified tab. Clear-and-return by default.

clear.description: If true, clear buffer after returning. Default true.

tab_handle.description: Optional; defaults to current browsing context.

name: browser_dialogs
description: List and respond to browser dialogs. Actions: "list" to query, "respond" to accept, "dismiss" to cancel. For JS prompt dialogs, provide inputText.

name: close_tab
description: Close a browser tab by its handle.

handle.description: Handle of the tab to close.

name: create_tab
description: Create a new browser tab, optionally loading a URL. Returns the UUID and info of the new tab.

url.description: Optional URL to load in the new tab.

name: evaluate_javascript
description: Execute a JavaScript function body within the page. The script may contain multiple statements; add an explicit `return` for any value you want back. Use `$uid(N)` to reference DOM elements by their UID from get_page_content output (e.g. `return $uid(42).href`). When `frameId` is set, runs inside that iframe. Prefer get_page_content for reading page text or structure — reach for it with `region: "entire_page"` or relaxed filters before scripting a DOM scrape here. Reserve this tool for actions or computations that text extraction can't express.

expression.description: JavaScript code to evaluate, treated as a function body. Use an explicit `return` for a value. Supports $uid(N) macros.

frameId.description: UID of an iframe element from get_page_content output. When set, the expression runs inside that iframe instead of the main frame.

name: get_network_request
description: Return full detail for a single recorded network request (headers, body when text and within size cap, timing).

request_id.description: Inspector request id, as returned by list_network_requests.

name: get_page_content
description: Extract the text content of a page using WebKit's text extraction. This is the preferred way to read a page — favor it over screenshots or scripting the DOM with evaluate_javascript. If the content you need is missing, widen the extraction (e.g. `region: "entire_page"`, a larger `maxWordsPerParagraph`, or relaxed node/URL filters) before reaching for those tools. Use the returned node UIDs (e.g. `uid=42`) with `page_interactions` and `evaluate_javascript` (`$uid(42)`). Output ≥ 32 kB is saved to a temp file; the path is returned. Pass `savePath` to always write to disk.

format.description: Output format (default: "textTree"). "text" is an alias for "textTree".

includeAccessibilityAttributes.description: Include accessibility attributes like role/aria-label (default: true).

includeEventListeners.description: Include click/hover/touch event listener info (default: false).

includeRects.description: Include bounding rects for text nodes (default: false).

includeSubframes.description: Also extract content from cross-origin subframes (default: false).

includeURLs.description: Include URL attributes like href/src (default: true).

maxWordsPerParagraph.description: Truncate paragraphs to this many words (default: 15). Use a larger value when you need full prose; smaller saves tokens.

nodeIds.description: Which nodes get UIDs (default: "interactive"; ignored when format is "markdown" or "plainText").

region.description: Extraction region (default: "viewport"). Use "entire_page" to capture beyond the visible scrollport.

savePath.description: File path to write the extraction to. When set, the path is returned instead of inline content.

shortenURLs.description: Strip query params and noise from URLs (default: true).

name: list_network_requests
description: List network request summaries (URL, method, status, timing) recorded by Inspector for the current or specified tab.

clear.description: If true, drain and reset the per-tab buffer.

status_max.description: Inclusive upper bound on response status.

status_min.description: Inclusive lower bound on response status.

since.description: ISO8601 timestamp; only requests started at or after this time are returned.

tab_handle.description: Browsing-context handle. Defaults to active tab.

name: list_tabs
description: List all open browser tabs with their handles, titles, and URLs.

name: navigate_to_url
description: Navigate to a URL and return the loaded page's extracted content. Auto-creates a tab if none is open, waits for the navigation to complete, and uses the format/options from the most recent get_page_content call (or sensible defaults). Output ≥ 32 kB is saved to a temp file.

tab_uuid.description: UUID of the tab to navigate. If omitted, uses the active tab.

name: page_info
description: Get information about the current page including URL, title, and loading state.

name: page_interactions
description: Perform DOM interactions in sequence. Actions: click, type, keyPress, scroll, selectText, selectMenuItem, hover, highlightText. **Prefer batch mode** whenever possible — provide all related interactions in a single call instead of separate calls (faster, single round-trip, single diff). Returns a diff of page changes after the batch (or full text if >50% changed); pass `fullText: true` to disable diffing. If a click triggers a navigation, the tool waits for it to finish and returns the loaded page's content. The diff/full text uses the format set by the most recent `get_page_content` call. Output ≥ 32 kB is saved to a temp file. Reference elements by node UID from `get_page_content`; fall back to `text` for find-in-page when no UID is available.

fullText.description: Return the full updated page text instead of a diff (default: false).

interactions.description: Sequence of interactions, executed sequentially with a 400 ms settle between each.

node.description: Node UID from get_page_content output. When omitted, `text` is treated as a find-in-page search; when both are set, the search is scoped to the subtree under `node`.

point.description: Viewport coordinates. Last resort when node and text are unavailable.

pressReturn.description: For `type`: simulate Return after typing to submit (default: false).

purpose.description: Short description of the intended outcome.

replaceAll.description: For `type`: replace existing field text instead of appending (default: false).

scrollToVisible.description: Scroll the target element into view before interacting (default: false).

text.description: Find-in-page query, scroll search term, or menu item label. Optional when `node` is provided.

value.description: Text to type, or key name to press.

name: screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the current page and save it as a PNG. Returns the file path (never inline base64). Defaults to the visible viewport; pass `full_page: true` for the entire scrollable page. Pass `savePath` to write to a specific location, otherwise the PNG is saved to a temporary file. Prefer get_page_content for reading a page — its text extraction is cheaper and more reliable than reading a screenshot. Use this only when the visual rendering itself matters (e.g. layout, charts, or verifying appearance).

full_page.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the viewport.

node.description: Node UID from get_page_content output to capture only that element. (Currently no-op pending dispatcher support; falls back to viewport.)

savePath.description: File path to write the PNG to. If omitted, the PNG is written to a temporary file.

name: set_emulated_media
description: Emulate a CSS media type (e.g. "screen" or "print") for responsive-design testing.

media.description: CSS media type to emulate, e.g. "screen" or "print". Empty string clears the override.

name: set_viewport_size
description: Set the browser viewport size in CSS pixels.

name: switch_tab
description: Switch to a different browser tab by its handle.

handle.description: Handle of the tab to switch to.

name: wait_for_navigation
description: Wait for the current page to finish loading. Returns the final URL and title.
